entry.title: feat(dsp): increase FM modulation depth and add dynamic gain scaling
entry.content:
commit 0bf6c24aa67c75302ebf8c789ff604d358a6381a parent 7981d2b75d7e8d030c0a693c50b52549cfacaac0 Author: minerva-jupiter <ryouturn@gmail.com> Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 10:36:54 +0900
feat(dsp): increase FM modulation depth and add dynamic gain scaling
- Increased FM depth multipliers significantly for more aggressive synthesis. - Added dynamic master gain scaling based on acceleration intensity ("Metal Zone" mode) to provide heavier saturation. - Updated WASM build artifacts.

entry.title: fix(dsp): adjust default mix, filter smoothing, and add denormal prevention
entry.content:
commit 7981d2b75d7e8d030c0a693c50b52549cfacaac0 parent 85771e7c460d8f3507872cd05242b131ef908f9c Author: minerva-jupiter <ryouturn@gmail.com> Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 14:12:50 +0900
fix(dsp): adjust default mix, filter smoothing, and add denormal prevention
- Update default oscillator mixes from 0.6 to 0.3. - Increase filter parameter smoothing constants for more stability. - Add small offset to filter input to prevent denormal numbers.

entry.title: feat(dsp): implement multi-oscillator engine and Kaoss Pad
entry.content:
commit 85771e7c460d8f3507872cd05242b131ef908f9c parent 54e3b09628623abebe5dcd243822c44ec37b3995 Author: minerva-jupiter <ryouturn@gmail.com> Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 13:49:10 +0900
feat(dsp): implement multi-oscillator engine and Kaoss Pad
- Add 3-oscillator architecture with FM modulation and selectable waveforms - Implement global Biquad LPF with Kaoss Pad UI touch controls - Add stateful `GeedbackProcessor` with parameter smoothing and Nyquist safety clamping - Update frontend to support real-time interaction and oscillator configuration - Include project documentation in README.md
